overview: The City Council and Community Development Board reviewed draft zoning amendments for the Boston Avenue corridor, hearing a consultant presentation on sub-districts, height incentives, and usage standards. The Council voted to refer the proposed district to the Community Development Board for further review and upcoming public hearings.

items.title: Presentation on Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District
items.summary: Consultants presented a proposal to create three sub-districts (BA1, BA2, and BA3) along Boston Avenue to facilitate mixed-use development with varying intensities, height incentives for public benefits, and specific dimensional standards for setbacks and green scores.

items.title: Council and Board Discussion of Proposed Zoning
items.summary: Members discussed refining housing definitions for lodging houses and dormitories, implementing parking reductions through Transportation Management Association membership, and ensuring adequate transitions between new developments and existing residential neighborhoods.

items.title: Public Comment on Corridor Zoning
items.summary: Public testimony included requests for purpose-built student housing categories, concerns about the scale of high-density buildings compared to existing homes, and requests for clear visualizations of proposed height transitions.

items.title: Update on Tufts Institutional Zone (Paper 24-033)
items.summary: The bodies discussed the timeline for drafting a campus-specific institutional zone, deciding to prioritize a framework for further discussion in the fall rather than pursuing immediate approval.

items.title: Referral of Paper 26-093
items.summary: Referred the proposed amendments for the Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District to the Community Development Board.
